alexa_skill.title: Brainstorm › Alexa
alexa_skill.description:
**Native** works without setup: say "Alexa, note ...". Alexa may report an error first, then Brainstorm saves the idea.

**Skill** gives one clean answer: say "Alexa, tell Brainstorm note ...". It needs your own free Alexa skill and a Home Assistant reachable from the internet.

**Both** accepts both ways.

data_description.voice_mode: Native uses the Alexa Media sentence without a skill. Skill and Both use your own Alexa skill.
data_description.go_back: Returns to the previous page without saving this form.

privacy.title: Brainstorm › Privacy & Users
privacy.description:
Off: everyone sees all ideas, as before. On: every idea belongs to its creator, and only they and the people it is shared with can see it in the cards. Share entries by long-pressing them on the card.

Note: To-do lists only show ideas shared with everyone, because everyone can read them. Admins can always read all data.

data_description.privacy_owner: Owns all existing ideas, and everything said to an Echo. Voice, briefing and review only mention this person's ideas.
data_description.privacy_export: These files contain all ideas and can be read by anyone with access to the config folder.
data_description.share_users: Leave empty to offer everyone. Use this to hide technical accounts such as MQTT.
data_description.privacy_enabled: Each person then sees only their own entries and what is shared with them.
data_description.go_back: Returns to the previous page without saving this form.
